preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) representing the number of registration requests.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) > 0 and line.islower() and line.isalpha() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1])
preconditions.description: Each of the next n lines is a non-empty string of lowercase Latin letters (length ≤ 32).

postconditions.expression: stdout.splitlines() == [process_request(requests[i], database) for i in range(n)]
postconditions.description: For each request in the input, the output line is the system's response: 'OK' if the name is available, or the smallest available namei (name + i) if the name is taken.

postconditions.expression: all(response == 'OK' or (response.startswith(name) and response[len(name):].isdigit()) for name, response in zip(requests, stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Every response is either 'OK' or a valid generated name (original name followed by a positive integer).

postconditions.expression: all(name not in database for name in requests if response == 'OK' for response, name in zip(stdout.splitlines(), requests))
postconditions.description: If the response is 'OK', the requested name is not present in the database after processing.

postconditions.expression: all((response != 'OK' and response in database) for response in stdout.splitlines() if response != 'OK')
postconditions.description: If the response is a generated name, it must be present in the database after processing.
